text: Thank you for seeing me today; I understand you are suffering from chronic joint pain. To help pinpoint the cause, can you tell me specifically which joints are affected and how long you have been experiencing this discomfort?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gout.
